/* 2026-11-12: 선택한 텍스트 포함 도시 이미지 / 풀 블리드 배너 */
.city-banner {
  position: relative;
  width: 100vw;
  max-width: none;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: 3 / 1;
  margin-left: calc(50% - 50vw);
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 0;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: none;
  background: #121f37;
}
.city-banner > img {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center center;
}
/* 새 배너 이미지에 작품명과 제목이 이미 포함되어 있으므로 이중 표기를 방지 */
.city-banner-shade,.city-banner-words {display: none !important;}
/* 최상단 브랜드 줄은 유지하되 배너를 화면 가장자리까지 확장 */
#passages {overflow: visible;}
@media (max-width: 650px) {
  .city-banner {
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 1;
    min-height: 0;
  }
  .city-banner > img {object-fit: contain;}
}
</style><script id="twine-user-script" role="script" type="text/twine-javascript">
/* 6rmo7KeQ 카카오톡 메시지 연출 */
window.setup = window.setup || {};

setup.initF5Chat = function () {
  const scene = document.querySelector(".f5-chat-scene");
  if (!scene) return;

  const area = scene.querySelector("#f5-chat-messages");
  const button = scene.querySelector("#f5-chat-next");
  const hint = scene.querySelector("#f5-chat-hint");

  const messages = [
    {
      sender: "친구2",
      side: "friend",
      text: "6re4656Y7IScIOyWtOuWu+qyjCDtlaDqsbDslbw/"
    },
    {
      sender: "나",
      side: "me",
      text: "64SI6rCAIOuovOyggCDsoJHqt7ztlbTspJg="
    },
    {
      sender: "친구2",
      side: "friend",
      text: "64K06rCAPw=="
    },
    {
      sender: "나",
      side: "me",
      text: "7JW8IOyeoOq5kOunjA=="
    }
  ];

  let step = 0;
  let busy = false;

  function addMessage(sender, side, content) {
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    wrapper.className = "f5-chat-message " + side;

    const name = document.createElement("div");
    name.className = "f5-chat-sender";
    name.textContent = sender;

    const bubble = document.createElement("div");
    bubble.className = "f5-chat-bubble";
    bubble.textContent = content;

    wrapper.appendChild(name);
    wrapper.appendChild(bubble);
    area.appendChild(wrapper);

    area.scrollTop = area.scrollHeight;
  }

  button.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (busy) return;

    if (step < messages.length) {
      const message = messages[step];

      addMessage(
        message.sender,
        message.side,
        message.text
      );

      step++;

      if (step === messages.length) {
        busy = true;
        button.disabled = true;
        hint.textContent = "…";

        setTimeout(function () {
          if (!scene.isConnected) return;

          area.classList.add("f5-chat-vanish");

          setTimeout(function () {
            if (!scene.isConnected) return;

            area.replaceChildren();
            area.classList.remove("f5-chat-vanish");

            button.disabled = false;
            button.textContent = "다시 화면을 누른다";
            hint.textContent = "대화 기록이 사라졌다.";
            busy = false;
          }, 600);
        }, 850);
      }

      return;
    }

    if (step === messages.length) {
      addMessage("친구2", "friend", "왜?");
      step++;
      button.disabled = true;
      button.textContent = "대화가 멈췄다";
      hint.textContent = "";
    }
  });
};


/* 나방 발생 노드 */

setup.initMothScene = function () {
  const scene = document.querySelector(".moth-scene");
  if (!scene) return;

  const button = scene.querySelector("#moth-mirror-button");
  const reveal = scene.querySelector("#moth-mirror-reveal");

  if (!button || !reveal) return;

  button.addEventListener("click", function () {
    reveal.hidden = false;
    button.hidden = true;

    setTimeout(function () {
      if (!scene.isConnected) return;

      reveal.scrollIntoView({
        behavior: "smooth",
        block: "center"
      });
    }, 100);
  }, { once: true });
};
</script><tw-passagedata name="계속되는 알람음" pid="1" position="825,250" size="100,100" tags="">
